findings.title: [SEC] gitleaks not installed (secret scan skipped)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the repo-side check passes. .github/workflows/secret-history-scan.yml:27-40 installs gitleaks 8.30.1 from the release tarball and verifies its SHA-256 (GITLEAKS_SHA256 551f6fc8...) before running the full-history scan (lines 42-47) and the allowlist probe scripts/ci/verify-gitleaks-config.sh:1-47; README.md:328 and docs/CI.md:28 document the pinned install. The deterministic lens still prints this row because the audit host has no gitleaks binary (tools/deterministic_checks.py:166 is environment-dependent, not a repo gap) - run output at 7dd0402 is otherwise identical to 8d299b8.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] 3 container image(s) without a digest pin
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the deployed images are digest-pinned. deploy-do.yml:897-904 refuses to deploy when API_DIGEST/WORKER_DIGEST/WEB_DIGEST are missing and exports MCT_<SERVICE>_IMAGE with @sha256 refs (attestation-verified first); third-party-image-scan.yml:51-61 fails on any literal (non-$) image ref in infra/digitalocean/docker-compose.yml without @sha256 (all four third-party images carry digests). The compose tag fallbacks (docker-compose.yml:82,160,233) remain for manual operator runs and are documented at docker-compose.yml:74-80, so the deterministic static check keeps flagging them by design; they are not used by the deploy path.
